issues.title: [dkblinux98/nyxGPT] fix: state the shipped chat model once, and read it everywhere else (PR #4034)
findings: Rendering the ConfigMap without the StatefulSet breaks the applied manifests' own invariant — custom-model k8s installs go from "wrong model, works" to "configured model, chat 404s while everything is Ready"
`test_rendering_never_fails_an_install` never executes the path it claims to pin

Both smokes discard the model-read's stderr (`2>/dev/null` in `_shipped_models` / `_resolve_models`), so a failed read prints only "could not read the shipped chat model" with no cause. `load_config` raises `FileNotFoundError` when `~/.nyxGPT/config.ini` is absent — a new parse-time prerequisite for `scripts/k8s-local-smoke.sh` that its "Prerequisites" header does not mention (CI seeds the config first, so the jobs are ordered correctly; a developer on a fresh machine gets the blind failure). Capture stderr into the failure message.
Naming inconsistency between the two new override knobs: `NYXGPT_SMOKE_EMBED_MODEL` (artifact smoke) vs `NYXGPT_SMOKE_EMBEDDING_MODEL` (local smoke).

§1e sweep result, for the record — remaining literal sites of the class after this PR: `k8s/configmap.yaml:9` + `k8s/statefulset-ollama.yaml:52` (deliberately kept readable, guarded by `test_k8s_manifests.py`, and the subject of Medium 1 / change 4); `docker-compose.yml:63` (`${NYXGPT_DEFAULT_MODEL:-qwen3.5:0.8b}` fallback — internally consistent since env-sync writes the var from config and both Compose consumers read the same var); stale `qwen2.5:0.5b` example values in `docs/configuration.md:357` and `docs/troubleshooting.md:439` (pre-existing doc drift, not falsified by this PR).
